ideas.pitch: A predictive spatial-temporal incident forecasting tool built specifically for UNC Chapel Hill campus safety data, providing calibrated 90% prediction intervals for campus security resource allocation.
ideas.title: Tarheel Campus Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hard-engineering prediction pattern seen in winning forecasting projects by applying rigorous statistical methods like Poisson regression to local data rather than relying on generic AI wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student commuter support platform optimizing Chapel Hill transit routes, combining LangGraph and localized RAG to help students navigate campus transportation efficiently.
ideas.title: Carolina GreenTransit Multi-Agent Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the multi-agent student support pattern that won the GreenNovation Hackathon, providing hyper-localized utility that directly appeals to student and university judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform integrated with local Chapel Hill farmers market inventories to deliver personalized meal recommendations and hyper-local dietary insights.
ideas.title: Triangle Local Food AI Nutrition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on the winning formula of the E-Foodiee nutrition assistant by tailoring the wellness concept specifically to the local community economy.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace facilitating micro-grants and project funding for student startups using USDC escrow payments tailored for university pitch events.
ideas.title: Triangle Angel Investor Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the successful Dispatch autonomous agent and USDC escrow architecture, offering judges a fully functional fintech utility with real transaction logic.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust verification engine tailored for student-run clinics and local regional healthcare providers in North Carolina.
ideas.title: UNC Health Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the proven architecture of the Global-Smile healthcare trust engine, solving a concrete business and trust problem that local medical judges immediately understand.
